editorial:
Imagine being a rich kid from Paris who has everything, then suddenly losing your sense of safety after a brutal attack. That is where you meet Achille. He is sent to a quiet beach town to heal and get his life back together, but the peace does not last long. He crosses paths with Brian, a local guy who is full of rage and looks for any excuse to fight. The vibe starts off slow and moody, but it quickly turns into a dangerous game of cat and mouse. You will feel the tension build as these two opposites clash, making you wonder who is actually the villain in this story.

What really works here is how the acting shows the raw anger between the two leads. The pacing is steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you want non-stop action. However, the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy dark stories about human nature, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the gritty details of the scenery. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move to keep this hidden gem forever.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking flip in power. After a long battle of wills and violence, the soft and broken Achille finally snaps. He stops being the victim and becomes the predator. In the final scenes, he turns the tables on Brian, proving that the trauma he suffered turned him into something far more dangerous than Brian ever was. He emerges as a cold killer, leaving you to realize the cycle of violence has just started over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological battles and dark character studies.
